endings/epilogue_depths.title: Depths of the axis
endings/epilogue_depths.body:
The stone **drops**: you didn't close the dungeon — you **changed** **strata**. Here silence **weighs** like a lower ceiling; the air is **old** before it reaches your lungs.

*(You can **save** from the menu or **start over** whenever you like.)*

shared/explore_nav_act2.title: Perimeter of the tunnels
shared/explore_nav_act2.body:
**Silence** is not absence of sound — it is the stone's **decision**. Each step **asks** whether you return to the Vigil's fire or **stay** with the echo.

With the **torn map**, you see where the corridor **lies** least; without it, you have only **skin** and **haste**.

choices.text: Patrol at random (random encounter)
choices.preview: Without moving on the map — the tunnels choose for you.

choices.text: Return to the crossroads hub
choices.preview: Retreat, raise shelter, and keep current stress.

shared/explore_nav_act3.title: Perimeter of the depths
shared/explore_nav_act3.body:
In the **depths**, echo chews names before returning them. The map promises no exit — only **direction**.

With the **torn map** in your head, you see where the stone **lies** less. Without it, only **ear** and **haste** remain.

choices.text: Patrol at random (random encounter)
choices.preview: Without moving on the map — the depths decide in violence.

choices.text: Retreat to the depths core
choices.preview: Return to the hub and keep current stress.

shared/explore_nav_act5.body: Snow erases new and old footprints with the same indifference. What changes is who can still read the trace.

shared/explore_nav_act6.title: Columns of the fractured nave
shared/explore_nav_act6.body: Each column repeats a broken oath. To walk here is to choose which crack will answer first.

choices.text: Wander among the columns (random encounter)
choices.preview: Without moving on the map — the void chooses the next step.

shared/game_over.title: Journey's End
shared/game_over.body:
Something in you **gives** without a crash — emptiness that leaves no echo. The **Dungeon of Silence** **opens** and **closes** like a wound; your name becomes a whisper in the damp.

If there is thread, descend again: the abyss does not fill — **silence** does, and notes.

choices.text: Start over

shared/kael_act2_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **word** **broke**. What remains is **counting** — and the **grey one** **already** **advances**.

shared/kael_act5_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **frost** **bites** the **phrase**. What remains is **iron** — and **trail** that **does not** **deny** **duel**.

shared/kael_act6_blades.title: Iron in the rib
shared/kael_act6_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **void** **swallows** the **last** **syllable**. The **echo** **falls silent** — the **grey one** **does not**.

choices.text: Measure iron with Kael

shared/kaelsworn_oath.title: Oath of ash
shared/kaelsworn_oath.body:
**Kael** removes his **helm** — tired face, clean gaze.

> *"**Three** times I fell. **Three** times you did not lie in the strike. That is **enough**: I serve as **iron** that only bends to **your** hand."*

choices.text: Accept — sword to one who beat you three times
diaryTexts: Kael bent the blade: not vassal, shadow with weight. Three falls of his became a name at my side.

shared/kaelsworn_post_act2.title: Iron that yields
shared/kaelsworn_post_act2.body:
**Kael** inclines his helm; the metal **breathes** as one who **keeps** a phrase for **later**.

> *"It was not victory — it was **counting**. When the **number** **closes**, the **iron** **speaks**."*

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Withdraw — there is a door and there is haste

onEnterDiaryTexts: Kael retreated in the bone room — not from fear, from measure. The grey trail stayed on the floor like a deferred promise.

shared/kaelsworn_post_act4.title: Iron at the threshold
shared/kaelsworn_post_act4.body:
**Kael** **anchors** his **sword** in the **shadow** of the **step** — **not** as **threat**, as **marker**.

> *"The **axis** **bends**; I **do not**. **Count** **again**."*

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Withdraw toward the ice

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the threshold of the grey wind, Kael bent for the length of a heartbeat. The throne stayed behind; the trail, ahead.

choices.text: Hear what the iron promises — oath
Retreat to camp — the lair waits

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the door of the white breath, Kael scraped ice from his shoulder as one scraping a name. Three counted blows — the iron wanted to speak.

onEnterDiaryTexts: On the rib the map denies, Kael touched his breastplate as one closing a book. The void heard the iron without contest.
